format: RGB8 PNG, no alpha, sRGB flag absent: read the bytes as linear data (disable colour management / sRGB decode)
R: signed distance to the outline, pt: value = 0.5 + d/48 (d > 0 outside, < 0 inside), range +-24 pt, sample bilinear
G: arc length along the outline from the electrodes: 0 at the lower tip, 1 where both heads meet at the top vertex; each chain is normalised separately, interior = inverse-square blend of the two chains (continuous), outside = nearest outline point
B: bevel light for the dead metal, key light top-left (az 315, el 45): 0.5 flat, > 0.5 lit edge, < 0.5 shaded edge; only non-0.5 inside the chamfer ring

gap_cut_disc.note: silhouette space (origin top-left of the 40 x 60 box). Remove the tube (core, tube, glass) inside this disc; the dead fill and bloom stay. Two electrode studs r 0.85 pt sit at the centre +-1 pt along the tip tangent (see bolt-day.svg #electrode-a/b).
